title: Caching and Invalidation
focus: Cache placement, eviction, invalidation, coherence, stampede protection, and cache failure modes.

pacing.review: Skim the six lessons and map one cache you already operate.
pacing.standard: Study lessons, complete exercises, and write one cache policy decision.
pacing.deep: Prototype one cache failure and a repaired policy locally.

learning_outcomes.statement: Choose cache placement from read/write path, freshness, authority, and failure cost.
Explain eviction policy behavior and estimate hit-rate economics.
Design invalidation and coherence rules without hiding stale or private data risks.
Prevent cache stampedes with request coalescing, jitter, leases, and bounded regeneration.
Defend a cache policy with ownership, observability, rollback, and abuse controls.

lab.note: Draft module; executable cache lab is deferred. Use the exercises to model a cache policy locally.

optional_project.description: Choose one real cache and write a policy memo covering keys, TTLs, invalidation, stampede controls, privacy, observability, and rollback.
